headline: Dorian LPG Board declares irregular dividend of $1.00 per share

headline: Stride Reports Record Revenue and Earnings

headline: Manhattan Associates Reports Record Revenue and Earnings

rationale: Q4 2023 revenue rose 62% YoY to $302.7M and GAAP net income rose to $37.7M ($0.70/share) from $10.6M ($0.20), with 2024 guidance reiterated and a new buyback authorization.

rationale: Revenue rose 27.0% to $66.5M and GAAP net income rose 39.1% to $15.7M (diluted EPS $2.77 vs $1.99) on higher volumes and selling prices, a clear YoY beat.

rationale: Revenue rose 13% to $337M, above the high end of its outlook, GAAP net income rose to $15M ($0.21 diluted EPS vs $0.11), non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose 25%, and full-year outlook was raised.

headline: Yelp Reports Third Quarter 2023 Financial Results
rationale: Record revenue of $345.1M (+12%), GAAP net income of $58.2M vs $9.1M ($0.79 diluted EPS vs $0.13), non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA up 30%, and full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook raised.
